text: A team gets 3 points for a win and 1 for a draw. After 10 games they're unbeaten on 22 points. How many have they won?
why: Every game is a win or a draw; 10 draws would be 10 points, and each win adds 2 more: (22 − 10) ÷ 2 = 6.

text: A knockout cup starts with 64 teams and has no replays. How many matches does it take to find the winner?
why: Every match knocks out exactly one team, and 63 teams have to go.
